claim: Piecewise resource and age/work associations yield a compact regional-transfer predictor of the reported inability-to-pay response.
interpretation: A saturation-shaped resource association is consistent with heterogeneous liquidity constraints, but proxies/topcodes and overlapping self-reports preclude identifying a physical/economic threshold.
falsification: Very small margin over flexible comparator; source-aware cross-section and onlytenheldstates; endpoint is hypothetical response, not observed emergency outcome.

known_prior_art.known: Official SHED public data/codebook; emergency expense resilience is a published descriptive endpoint. Resource equivalence and age/life-cycle associations are prior model families, not established causal mechanisms in this snapshot.

scope: Positive-weight complete cases, state-balanced within-state survey-weighted predictive risk; not national prevalence or causal financial access. Income proxy upper bracket175k is a modeling convention. D1A0 reflects no paid work, not unemployment or a job-loss shock.
